children: McDonald's Corp. (MCD) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 23, 2026.

On September 23, 2026, the Company issued an investor release announcing new targets to advance its McDonald's > NEXT strategy. A copy of the related investor release is being filed as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference in its entirety.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/63908/000006390826000076/mcd-20260923.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/63908/000006390826000076/0000063908-26-000076-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
